subject: layer_rects: incorrect position of tickmarks and labels in nominal axis after data input change

messages.author: da366e22631d2bf1
messages.subject: layer_rects: incorrect position of tickmarks and labels in nominal axis after data input change
parts:
Hi everyone,

I would like to make a shiny app which shows a heatmap for different group of genes. The group of genes is an input variable which can be selected by the user.
The first plot rendered by the application is fine. All the labels and tickmarks are nicely aligned. However after selecting different group of genes (which has different size) the tickmarks and labels are not anymore correctly aligned with shown data.

I copied below a short example.
Thanks for help
Robert

library(shiny)
library(reshape2)
library(ggvis)

set.seed(12345)
data <- matrix(rnorm(5000), nrow=250, ncol=20, dimnames=list(paste0("gene_", 1:250), paste0("sample_", 1:20)))

cellInfo <- function(x) {
    if(is.null(x)) return(NULL)
    sprintf("%s</br>%s", x$Genes, x$Samples)
}

runApp(list(
    ui = bootstrapPage(
        selectInput('n', 'Number of rows', choices=c(2, 10, 50, 250), selected=10),
        ggvisOutput('plot')
    ),
    server = function(input, output) {
        heatData <- reactive({
            indx <- 1:input$n
            data <- t(scale(t(data[indx,])))
            ## clustering
            rows.lev <- hclust(as.dist(1-cor(t(data))))$order
            cols.lev <- hclust(as.dist(1-cor(data)))$order
            data <- data[rows.lev, cols.lev]
            ## melt
            data <- melt(data, varnames=c("Genes","Samples"), value.name="Values")
            data
        })
       
       
        heatData %>%
            ggvis(~Samples, ~Genes, fill = ~Values) %>%
                layer_rects(width = band(), height = band(), strokeWidth := 0) %>%
                    add_tooltip(cellInfo,"hover") %>%
                        scale_nominal("x", padding = 0, points=FALSE) %>%
                            scale_nominal("y", padding = 0, points=FALSE) %>%
                                add_axis("x", properties=axis_props(labels=list(angle=90)), tick_padding = 50, title_offset=120) %>%
                                    add_axis("y", title_offset=80) %>%
                                        bind_shiny("plot")
    }
))
